articles.summary: The Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program Provides $10,000 Scholarships to 30 High School Seniors and 20 Graduate Students Nationwide In celebration of National Scholarship Month, Sallie today announced the newest recipients of its Bridging the Dream Scholarship Program. The Sallie Mae Fund, in partnership with the Thurgood Marshall College Fund (TMCF), awarded $500,000 in scholarships to help students access and complete higher education. Through this year’s program, 30 high school seniors received $10,000 scholarships based on financial need, academic achievement, leadership, and service. In addition, 20 graduate students pursuing advanced degrees also received $10,000 scholarships. Since 2021, The Sallie Mae Fund has awarded more than $5.5 million in scholarships to nearly 1,500 students through its Bridging the Dream and Completing the Dream Scholarship Programs . articles.title: Sallie Awards $500,000 in Scholarships to Help Students Advance Their Education and Career Goals
